# Installer language resources

ChineseSimplified.isl is the user-contributed Chinese translation distributed in
the official Inno Setup source, pinned to is-6_7_3:
https://github.com/jrsoftware/issrc/blob/is-6_7_3/Files/Languages/Unofficial/ChineseSimplified.isl

Original translator attribution remains in the file. The upstream distribution's
license is included as INNO-LICENSE.txt. Cupbox-specific wizard copy overrides
selected messages in ../cupbox.iss.
